title: Incorporation of quantitative imaging data using artificial intelligence improves risk prediction in veterans with liver disease
summary: Methods/Results §§2–4: automated CT imaging biomarkers were combined with eCTP in 4,614 veterans; mortality C-index rose 0.64 to 0.73 and future decompensation 0.67 to 0.80. Retrospective regional VA cohort proof of concept.
